QuestInfo.name: Omelet Ingredients
QuestInfo.0: Anna wanted to make something. Maybe Alpha and Beta could help her.
QuestInfo.1: Anna wants to make sick Maya an omelet but she does not have eggs nor milk. She is requesting that you get the ingredients she needs. You can get the #reggs#k from #bUtah#k and you can get the #rmilk#k from a  #bDairy Cow.#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought egg and milk for Anna so she can make the omelet. Anna has given you one of her omelets for bringing her the ingredients.

0.0: I'm so worried about Maya. She's always been a little weak, but she gets sick all the time now. I hope it's nothing serious...
0.1: Maya can't eat anything when she's sick. However, she liked my omelet last time. I'd like to make her another, so if you aren't busy, could you please get some ingredients for me? Meanwhile, I'll make my special secret sauce.

yes.0: I have most of the ingredients. I'm just missing the most important ones, eggs and milk. Would you get some for me? #r#t4033817# x 5#k and #r#t4033818# x 3#k will be enough. You can get milk from a #bDairy Cow#k and eggs from #bUtah#k.

no.0: There isn't enough time to get the ingredients and also make the sauce. This is awful.

1.0: Did you bring all the ingredients for the omelet?
1.1: Great. Now it's time to show my skills!

yes.0: I made plenty! Here, you should have some too.

default.0: To make an omelet, I need #r#t4033818# x 3#k and #r#t4033817# x 5#k. You can get #r#t4033818##k from #bUtah#k and #r#t4033817##k from a #bDairy Cow#k.
